archiveItems.title: Historical AI and prompt material boundary
archiveItems.promotion_rule: Historical AI outputs may inform reviews but do not become official direction without a reviewed source-of-truth update.
archiveItems.risk: Archive material can be mistaken for current SEIS direction.
archiveItems.next_action: Keep archive references separate from active goals until promoted by review.

archiveItems.title: Tracked deletion review candidates
archiveItems.promotion_rule: Deleted or orphaned material needs a dedicated repository hygiene review before restore, archive, replacement, or approved removal.
archiveItems.risk: Unreviewed deletion staging can mix unrelated work into Goal Tracking commits.
archiveItems.next_action: Keep deletion decisions out of Goal Tracking OS commits.

archiveItems.title: Deferred public and release readiness claims
archiveItems.promotion_rule: Public or release readiness claims require dry-run evidence and cannot be promoted from roadmap intent alone.
archiveItems.risk: Readiness language can overstate current repository maturity.
archiveItems.next_action: Run readiness dry-runs only after repository hygiene is resolved.
